note: NECO Biology round 5 (R32 top-up): bacterial cell without a nucleus, vacuole's sap, lysosomes; peristalsis, HCl's acid medium, sugar-to-acid tooth decay, roughage; platelets and plasma; diaphragm and ribs in inspiration, mucus-lined windpipe; blind spot, rods for dim light, accommodation by the lens; ADH on kidney tubules, progesterone and the uterus lining, thyroxine and metabolism; ovule to seed, ovary to fruit, wind-pollinated flowers, binary fission, yeast budding, cassava cuttings; the test cross, colour blindness on the X, phenotype, codominance in group AB; CO2 removed by photosynthesis, nitrogen fixation, energy falling along the chain, habitat; kwashiorkor, measles by droplets; haustoria, gill filaments; the potometer, the control experiment. Scanned against NECO rounds 1-4, WAEC Biology (all rounds) and the JAMB pool.
